meaning:
ὑπόδημα, -τος, τό
(ὑποδέω), [in LXX for נָעַל ;]
a sole bound under the foot, a sandal: Mat.3:11 10:10, Mrk.1:7, Luk.3:16 10:4 15:22 22:35, Jhn.1:27; τ. ποδῶν, Act.7:33 (LXX) Act.13:25.†
SYN.: σανδάλιον, q.v (AS)

He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will…
He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
